findings.point: Mandatory original flagged states, opposite-policy inputs and own zero-map controls are reserved before deterministic receiver-count/policy coverage and newly recovered large-diameter cases. The 900-input cap and overflow reporting are explicit.

Strong search calls the original audited solver. Objective observer returns the original value unchanged; local-search observer returns the original result unchanged. No reference positions, WCL output or localization error enters solver or escalation.

Candidate capture retains all strong initials and endpoints/fallbacks, original primary incumbent, strict improving objective evaluations and final audit incumbent. Local-coordinate representation avoids large-global-coordinate precision loss for captured points.

The one-stage escalation rule matches the locked design: original nonconvergence, objective improvement above its scale-dependent threshold, or more than 1 m incumbent movement. Each executed stage has the stated 30000/100000 maximum split budget.
Earlier stages remain on disk. Best objective stage and last-stage numerical gap are reported separately. Original primary estimates are read-only and never replaced.

verify_targeted_audits reports maximum recorded-versus-recomputed candidate objective difference but does not reject a material value automatically. Inspect this statistic against 1e-8 dB², or add an external final gate without editing locked execution code.

An expanded all-found sensitivity analysis should union the original primary candidate pool and all retained audit stages before applying a band relative to the union minimum. A new 1000-evaluation endpoint does not preserve the old 200-evaluation endpoint by itself. Primary and enhanced analyses may also remain explicitly separate; do not describe a stage-only pool as all candidates ever found.

Numerically guarded bounds are not directed-rounding proofs. Small objective gap does not establish unique position. Retain both widely separated competitive candidates and unresolved gaps regardless of whether selected incumbent movement is small.

scope: Full reading of schedule preparation, targeted audit execution, verification, and the original solver read earlier. No optimizer run and no code modifications. This static review is not completed numerical verification.
